description: This file defines a base activity class for Android samples, handling logging setup and lifecycle methods.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class extending FragmentActivity, providing logging initialization and lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity is created; it calls the superclass's onCreate.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity becomes visible; it calls initializeLogging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging framework by creating a LogWrapper and attaching it to the Log system.
